brief: Plain poured-concrete silo about 14 ft across and 34 ft high, the shaft marked by pale horizontal pour-lift bands and water stains, open at the top with no roof. It is one of a pair standing tight against the board-sided gable end of a gambrel dairy barn, with a steel silage blower pipe and ladder cage propped against it and an old feed trough and implements in the grass at its foot; a vegetable garden and the farmhouse lie across the yard. (Poured concrete; nearest vocabulary type is concrete_stave.)
